description: Prints ostack's shipped model defaults (hooks/ostack-defaults.md) when a session starts, resumes, clears, or compacts, or on its first prompt if no session start printed them. Turns onyo-mode on for every prompt, and adds the onyo-projects rules in a Claude Projects session. In Projects it also prints the onyo-projects sections for the session's role when a session starts, resumes, clears, or compacts. A line saying `onyo-mode off` in CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, or the project instructions turns it off for the project, and one in a message turns it off for the session. In a Projects coordinator it also refuses a start_thread_session call whose brief lacks the `onyo-projects: planning thread` or `onyo-projects: unit thread` line. In a Projects coordinator it also blocks the end of a turn once when the turn received a thread's report and the coordinator did not post it in the project chat.
